description: Get a channel resource by id (defaults to the current channel).

channel_id.description: Optional channel id; defaults to the current channel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a channelListResponse with the channel item; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List videos by id(s) or channel, with pagination.

video_id.description: Optional comma-separated video id(s) to fetch.

channel_id.description: Optional channel id to list videos for (defaults to the current channel).

max_results.description: Maximum number of videos to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of videos to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a videoListResponse with items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update snippet and/or status fields of a video.

video_id.description: The id of the video to update.

snippet.description: Optional snippet fields to update (title, description, tags, categoryId, defaultLanguage).

status.description: Optional status fields to update (privacyStatus, embeddable, publishAt).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the updated video; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a video and remove it from any playlists.

video_id.description: The id of the video to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List playlists by id(s) or channel, with pagination.

playlist_id.description: Optional comma-separated playlist id(s) to fetch.

channel_id.description: Optional channel id to list playlists for (defaults to the current channel).

max_results.description: Maximum number of playlists to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of playlists to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a playlistListResponse with items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a new playlist from a snippet (title required).

snippet.description: Snippet object with at least a 'title' and optional 'description'.

status.description: Optional status object with a privacyStatus.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the created playlist; on failure (missing title), output contains an error message.

description: Update snippet and/or status fields of a playlist.

playlist_id.description: The id of the playlist to update.

snippet.description: Optional snippet fields to update (title, description).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the updated playlist; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a playlist and remove its items.

playlist_id.description: The id of the playlist to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List items of a playlist ordered by position, with pagination.

playlist_id.description: The id of the playlist whose items are listed.

max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a playlistItemListResponse with items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Add a video to a playlist via a snippet.

snippet.description: Snippet with playlistId and resourceId.videoId (and optional position).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the inserted playlist item; on failure (missing fields or playlist not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update a playlist item's position.

playlist_item_id.description: The id of the playlist item to update.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the updated playlist item; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Remove an item from its playlist.

playlist_item_id.description: The id of the playlist item to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List top-level comment threads filtered by video and moderation status.

video_id.description: Optional video id to filter threads by.

max_results.description: Maximum number of threads to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of threads to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a commentThreadListResponse with items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a new top-level comment thread on a video.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the created thread; on failure (missing fields), output contains an error message.

description: List reply comments under a parent comment, with pagination.

parent_id.description: The id of the parent comment whose replies are listed.

max_results.description: Maximum number of comments to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of comments to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a commentListResponse with items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Reply to a parent comment.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the created comment; on failure (missing fields or parent not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the text of a comment.

comment_id.description: The id of the comment to update.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the updated comment; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a comment and its replies.

comment_id.description: The id of the comment to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Set the moderation status of one or more comments.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output lists the updated ids and status; on failure (no matches), output contains an error message.

description: Search videos by query and channel with ordering and pagination.

channel_id.description: Optional channel id to restrict the search to.

q.description: Optional query matched against title, description, and tags.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a searchListResponse with items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List available video categories.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a videoCategoryListResponse with items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List caption tracks for a video.

video_id.description: The id of the video whose captions are listed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a captionListResponse with items; on failure (video not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the channel sections for a channel.

channel_id.description: The id of the channel whose sections are listed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a channelSectionListResponse with items; on failure (channel not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get aggregate analytics for the current channel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the channel analytics metrics; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get analytics for a single video by id.

video_id.description: The id of the video whose analytics are requested.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the video analytics metrics; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
